annotations.title: The emotional arc of a classic novel, its shape, and the novels whose arcs move most alike

description: For 'what is the emotional arc of X', 'does X end happier or sadder than it begins', 'where does X turn', 'which novels feel like X as they go'. Sentiment of the full Gutenberg text of 339 classic novels (1678-1928), scored in 100 parts and smoothed: start, end, the change and its rank among all 339, the shape by thirds (Rise, Fall, Rise–fall, Fall–rise), where the sharpest turn falls, the arc every 10%, and the 5 novels whose arcs correlate most closely. Fuzzy-matches the title; if the novel is not in the corpus it says so and lists the closest titles.

author.description: Optional author, to pick between similar titles

full_arc.description: true = also return all 100 points of the smoothed arc

title.description: The novel's title, e.g. 'Moby-Dick', 'Pride and Prejudice'
